title: Regularized Nystrom features and exact-RBF rank equivalence
formal_object: Unit query/candidate x,y, k(x,y)=exp(-||x-y||^2/(2 sigma^2)), sigma>0; train landmarks L and W=K_LL+rho I, rho>0.
assumptions: Both vectors must be unit normalized for the exact rank-equivalence statement.
Landmarks and hyperparameters fixed on train; output unnormalized feature maps.
Approximation can alter ranking, but that does not imply exact RBF supplies a new semantic nonlinear ranking.

operations.output: Exact RBF and dot product induce identical mathematical rankings.

derivation_steps.justification: Multiply the symmetric inverse-root factors; this is regularized Nystrom, not the unregularized Moore-Penrose formula.

derivation_steps.statement: ||x-y||^2=2-2x^T y, so k=exp((x^T y-1)/sigma^2) is strictly increasing in x^T y.
derivation_steps.justification: Exact norm expansion and positivity of the exponential derivative prove ranking equivalence, apart from finite-precision ties.

derivation_steps.statement: If |khat-k|<=epsilon for a query's candidates and k(x,c1)-k(x,c2)>2epsilon, their order is preserved.
derivation_steps.justification: Subtract the two approximation errors; no spectral bound alone certifies every small-margin native pair.

method_expression: Retain the existing regularized Nystrom feature construction only as a known low-rank/regularization tradeoff, output all candidate scores and compare to exact linear/RBF ties explicitly. Withdraw the original exact-RBF nonlinear-quality explanation.
distinguishing_prediction: If Nystrom improves a native ranking, the change must be caused by approximation/regularization (or numerical ties), not exact RBF expressivity on unit inputs.
falsifier: The claimed nonlinear gain is asserted despite equal exact rankings, or actual approximation/cost is worse than a simple linear reduced representation.
closest_alternative: Known Nystrom and ridge kernel features; exact RBF is a monotone transform of the unit dot score here.
decisive_comparison: Same unit features, landmarks/rank, all native candidates and total fit/transform/scoring costs; preserve tie policy. This is a correction/control need, not a new scientific direction.
legacy_code_audit: Legacy I16 uses the regularized factorization; C_RBF and C_PROJECTED must be rank-equivalent mathematically on the same unit features.
review_limit: Factor/rank identities reviewed; original quality explanation refuted under its own assumptions, efficacy and novelty pending.
